description: Negative fixture (ISSUE-012 / R5): a 3-node cycle on `main` edges. Structurally valid (unique names, all targets exist, connection types known) so ONLY the CYCLE_DETECTED rule fires. Note this is a validation golden, not a runtime case: n8n 2.9.4 allows runtime loops (allowCycles defaults to true for reference parity - golden case D6); the negative case is what `{ allowCycles: false }` must reject with the deterministic path message.
